nodes.text: What is hMPV, and why is it making headlines? Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a respiratory virus that can cause symptoms similar to the flu or common cold. While it’s usually mild, it can be more serious for young children, older adults, and people with weakened immune systems. https://t.co/CQ1dITlPHc
